CLOUD FIXER seat (recarry) for PR #2419 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (branch fix/r10-cloud-shape-pr, handoff topic r10-cloud-shape). Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from origin/main and follow them exactly.
Situation: main was red from 5756f2b1 until #2423, #2424 and #2420 merged; main is now green. This PR's head still carries the inherited reds (wave-script, delivery-status, pr-contract), and the orchestrator's remerge was refused because the body doesn't name the reds at the head. Task: start from the PR head (`git fetch origin fix/r10-cloud-shape-pr`), then `git merge origin/main` (never rebase), resolving any conflict soundly. Re-run prepr.sh and every check the body cites, and re-take the body IN FULL for the new head. Answer, in `## Red checks`, every red that remains on the PR head's latest CI; inherited reds that the main merge clears may be named as cleared by that merge, with cause. ALSO fold, in this pass: cloud_relay gains ONE probe arm that scans every refs/heads/probe/* ref. probe/rev-* refs are relayed and confirmed as now; any other new or moved probe ref is reported as an OWED line on every tick until disposed (a level, not a diff). Handoff refs with no open PR are reported OWED too. Add a self-test for each arm; this replaces the rev-only scan.
Return: push code to `handoff/r10-cloud-shape` (fast-forward; if the existing handoff ref is not an ancestor of your result, merge it in first) and the body via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-cloud-shape`. Push nothing else; do not open, edit, comment on or merge any PR. A fixer writes no delivery row. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha>.
